BaselineEntry.description:
The entry of a group names no file or function. One written before a group was keyed by its
modules names those of the import closing the cycle its report showed.

count.description: How many violation sites the entry allows.

path.description:
The file of the report, relative to the project root with forward slashes; left out for a
group of modules.

qualname.description:
The qualified name of the function the report is in; left out at module level and for a
group of modules.

rule_code.description: The code of the rule that reports (`EFF101`).

target.description: What the report is about, as the report names it.

description: On-disk shape: `version`, then `[[entries]]` sorted by key (minimal git diffs).

entries.description: The reports the baseline allows, sorted by path, qualified name, rule code, and target.

title: heki Ratchet baseline, version 2
